exercises.question: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 3 cm and height 7 cm.
exercises.question_amharic: ራዲየሱ 3 ሳ.ሜ እና ቁመቱ 7 ሳ.ሜ የሆነን ሲሊንደር ይዘት ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify r = 3, h = 7.\n2. Compute V = π * 3² * 7.\n3. V = π * 9 * 7 = 63π.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify r = 3, h = 7.\n2. Compute V = π * 3² * 7.\n3. V = π * 9 * 7 = 63π.
